scripts.check:all: pnpm run check:proto && pnpm run check:projection && pnpm run check:capabilities && pnpm run check:structural-rules && pnpm run check:runtime-events && pnpm run check:limits && pnpm run check:fn-map && pnpm run check:unicode-case && pnpm run check:runtime-versions && pnpm run check:zig && pnpm run check:format && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test:go:quality && pnpm test && pnpm run test:coverage
scripts.build: pnpm run build:zig:dist && (cd packages/ts/runtime && pnpm run build) && (cd packages/ts/scene-runner && pnpm run build)
scripts.check:zig: zig fmt --check packages/zig/build.zig packages/zig/host/src packages/zig/runtime/src packages/zig/scene-runner/src packages/zig/wasm/src && pnpm run test:zig
scripts.test:zig: zig build --build-file packages/zig/build.zig test && pnpm run test:zig:wasm && pnpm run test:native-conformance
scripts.test:zig:wasm: zig build --build-file packages/zig/build.zig wasm-test-artifact && node --no-warnings scripts/run-zig-wasm-tests.mjs
scripts.test:all: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && pnpm run test:zig && pnpm run build:zig && (cd packages/ts/runtime && ./node_modules/.bin/vitest --run) && (cd packages/ts/scene-runner && ./node_modules/.bin/vitest --run) && sh scripts/go-test.sh test && pnpm run build:zig:dist && (cd packages/ts/runtime && pnpm run build) && (cd packages/ts/scene-runner && pnpm run build) && node scripts/smoke-dist.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: env TMPDIR=/tmp pnpm run build:zig && (cd packages/ts/scene-runner && ./node_modules/.bin/vitest --run tests/e2e)
scripts.test:coverage:all: pnpm run build:zig && (cd packages/ts/runtime && ./node_modules/.bin/vitest --run --coverage) && (cd packages/ts/scene-runner && ./node_modules/.bin/vitest --run --coverage) && sh scripts/go-test.sh coverage
scripts.test:dist: pnpm run build:zig:dist && (cd packages/ts/runtime && pnpm run build) && (cd packages/ts/scene-runner && pnpm run build) && node scripts/smoke-dist.mjs
scripts.bench: (cd packages/ts/scene-runner && pnpm run build && node bench/runner-creation.mjs)
scripts.format: find packages/go/converter -path "*/vendor" -prune -o -name "*.go" -print | xargs gofmt -w && ./packages/ts/runtime/node_modules/.bin/oxfmt packages/ts/runtime/src packages/ts/scene-runner/src packages/ts/scene-runner/tests packages/ts/scene-runner/bench scripts "!packages/ts/scene-runner/src/types/turnout-model_pb.ts"
scripts.check:format: test -z "$(find packages/go/converter -path '*/vendor' -prune -o -name '*.go' -print | xargs gofmt -l)" && ./packages/ts/runtime/node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check packages/ts/runtime/src packages/ts/scene-runner/src packages/ts/scene-runner/tests packages/ts/scene-runner/bench scripts "!packages/ts/scene-runner/src/types/turnout-model_pb.ts"
scripts.test:go:quality: sh scripts/go-test.sh vet && sh scripts/go-test.sh race
